items.title: Bob Watts Interview, 1963-02-28
items.q: But my daddy taught them right in the backyard on Palmyre Street.

ctx.x: And, see, for years I guess, oh, before I was born, see, they was on the road, see, with this acrobat act, see. Mm-hmm. They even taught the great Gaines brothers of this city. They used to have a trucking company hauling trash and junk. Mm-hmm. But my daddy and them taught them. And then they went on the road to make a big name for themselves, see. Mm-hmm. But my daddy taught them right in the backyard on Palmyre Street. Mm-hmm. They had a wide yard there and they'd lay down the canvas first and then put that…
Yeah. But did you listen to the other musicians besides your father and your uncle much around?
